steps.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Boil the spaghetti for 10 minutes, until al dente.
Scoop out half a cup of the pasta water, then drain the spaghetti.
Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium-low heat.
Add the garlic and red pepper flakes and cook for 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Toss in the spaghetti, the pasta water and the parmesan until glossy.
Season with the salt, scatter the parsley on top, and serve right away.
